purpose: Calibrate dialogue that is embedded in continuous lived narration rather than isolated question-answer information exchange. Rebuild only failed CAL-02 and CAL-03 while using CAL-01-A as a positive anchor. No full-manuscript rewrite.

focus: facial and bodily reaction changing meaning

round2_targets.goal: Remove the feeling of a route-fact interview. Let Chu arrive as a person already doing something in danger; let Liu infer part of the route history from behavior/context; allow incomplete answers, physical interruption and listener reaction.

Make Huo feel physically present before he becomes a speaker. His age, grief, restraint, gaze, hands, weapon handling, distance from Liu, reaction to Huo Yun references, and response to the ledger information must participate in the conflict. Dialogue must not be a clean exchange of history and plot facts.

embodied_dialogue_requirement.core: Dialogue is one channel inside a continuous scene, not the whole scene.
must_test: what each body is doing before/during/after speech
what the focal character notices and misreads
how facial expression or gaze changes interpretation when materially relevant
how the listener reacts before answering
whether someone refuses, delays, ignores or redirects a question
whether the physical environment interrupts or changes the conversation
whether description changes pressure/timing/relationship rather than decorating the prose
forbidden_fake_fix: longer sentences as a quality proxy

acceptance.next_scale_requires: Human explicitly says at least one CAL-02 direction and one CAL-03 direction no longer feel mechanically AI-written.
